title: Move engine detection config out of CLI config
description:
As a maintainer, I want actor, property, and third-party detection config to live in the scanner package, so that analyzers and the classifier do not import CLI env code.

Feature: detection config move

  Scenario: Engine config travels with the engine
    Given property-detection-config, actor-detection-config, and third-party-detection-config
    When the scanner package is built
    Then those modules live in the scanner
    And CLI-only config (env, upload, redact, resolve) stays in the CLI
